title: A city you have been to and would like to visit again

prompt: Describe a city you have been to and would like to visit again
bullets: and explain why you would like to visit it again

part2.question: Describe a city you have been to and would like to visit again

segments.v: I want to talk about Hội An. It is an old town in the centre of Vietnam. I visited it with my family in the summer after grade 9. We stayed there for two days. We walked around the old town and ate cao lầu. It is a special noodle dish. We also went on a basket boat in the coconut forest. It was very fun. At night, there were many lanterns and the town was very beautiful. Hội An is quiet and peaceful. The old houses are yellow and very beautiful. There are not many cars. I want to visit it again because two days was too short. I want to go there on the full moon night to see the lantern festival. I also want to go to the beach.
